rca_of_the_issue.original_bug: When uploading spec sheets via drag-and-drop, files opened in browser tabs instead of uploading, crashing the browser
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Missing window-level drag guard - drops that missed the dropzone (or started outside it) hit the document's default handler which opens files in browser
fix_applied: 1. Added GlobalDragGuard component with window-level dragover/drop listeners that preventDefault for file drags only
2. Added onDragEnter handler to all dropzones (Safari fires dragenter before dragover, missing preventDefault locks cursor to 'no-drop')
3. GlobalDragGuard checks dataTransfer.types for 'Files' - only blocks external file drags, allows in-app drag-drop (Kanban, scheduler)
rca_of_the_issue.verification: Synthetic DragEvent tests confirm file drags are blocked at window level while text drags pass through
